en.metaTitle: Crochet Colorwork Squares: Tapestry, C2C and Granny Patterns
en.metaDesc: Multi-color crochet squares in your colors, written out in full in US terms: tapestry crochet charts, corner-to-corner graphs and granny squares, with a printable PDF.
en.lede: Choose a tapestry, corner-to-corner or granny design and set your colors, then get the chart and every row, diagonal or round of a complete square.
en.squareNote: A guide to the look of the finished square, with its edging.
en.indexLink: Multi-color squares: tapestry, corner-to-corner and granny
